name: Fix the Endless Independence War/修复无止尽的独立战争
short_description: Fixes endless independence wars in the base game caused by distant major powers freely joining—now only independent nations with over 50 Antagonism toward the overlord can intervene./修复原版附庸国独立战争因远方大国随意加入而无限拖延的问题——现在只有对宗主国敌意超过50的独立国家才能介入。
